rows.envelope_concern: gate/config (a config-parsing package) closes a 4-package SCC because its loader imports gate's types, the gate/factories registry, and the root config — mixing config parsing with gate construction.

gate/config and gate/factories depend on their parent package gate for the shared gate contract (GateFn type, acceptance runner), while gate depends back on both children via gate/registry.ts, closing a 4-package cycle through quay/src.

gate/config participates in a 4-package cycle (gate/config -> gate/factories -> root -> gate -> gate/config) only because config/loader.ts pulls in the gateFactories dispatch and gate pulls config's loader exports back.

rows.envelope_concern: gate/config is meant to be a low-level config reader but loader.ts makes it depend back on gate, gate/factories and quay/src, holding the package cycle together.

quay/src/gate/config is a child package that imports back up into its parent (GateFn from ../types.ts) and across to its sibling (gateFactories from ../factories/index.ts) and up to the package root (findConfig from quay/src/config.ts), which together with gate->config re-exports closes a 4-package SCC with gate, gate/factories and quay/src.

The shared gate contract type `GateFn` is owned by packages/quay/src/gate/types.ts (directory `src/gate`), forcing packages/quay/src/gate/factories and packages/quay/src/gate/config to import upward into quay/src/gate, contributing two of the four edges in the 4-node package cycle.
